response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.arcref AS arcref, p.fundflux AS fundflux, AVG(s.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux HAVING AVG(s.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS benchmark FROM g) SELECT g.arcref AS project_reference, g.fundflux AS funding_source, g.rate AS rate, g.rate - b.benchmark AS excess FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.benchmark ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A zero scan duration (spanmin = 0) is treated as a missing ratio (via NULLIF) and ignored, as are NULL gbsize or spanmin values.
Groups in which no scan has a computable ratio have no rate and are excluded from the benchmark average and from the output.
The benchmark is the unweighted mean of group rates across all groups (not filtered), and 'excess' is rate minus benchmark.
